messages:
zoe (new-hire): Hi team! Zoe here, first on-call rotation this week. Two quick blockers: I can't open a few runbook attachments, and my OpsGenie test page never reached my phone. Also where's the condensed 'first response' checklist?
max (oncall-lead): Welcome Zoe! Runbook = Confluence > Reliability > Oncall Runbooks. Attachments are ACL'd separately. Drop your SSO and @tess will add you. Condensed checklist is the yellow box at top of runbook titled 'First Response (30s)'.
tess (sre): Added zoe@redwood.com to runbook-attachments. Give it a refresh. For OpsGenie make sure Push + SMS enabled in profile and your device is enrolled in MDM.
zoe (new-hire): Refresh fixed attachments, thanks. OpsGenie test still times out with "delivery failed". I'm on iOS and push seems allowed.
tess (sre): If push allowed but delivery failed, try re-login in OpsGenie app and check Devices tab. Corporate MDM sometimes blocks background delivery until device shows as approved. If you see "unverified device" ping infra-bot.
infra-bot: ACTION: Device zoe-device pending MDM approval. Approve at https://mdm.redwood.internal/approve?device=zoe-device
zoe (new-hire): Approved. Re-sent test and got the push. Phew. One more: the 'exec notice' template in the runbook mentions CC'ing vpeng. Is there a short template I should copy-paste?
max (oncall-lead): Yes, use the exact exec template in runbook > Communication templates. Short form: "SEV1  <one-line impact>  mitigation underway  lead: <name> (<phone>)". CC @vpeng and @headops only for revenue-impacting Sev1s. If you're shadowed, have your shadow or lead sign-off before sending.
zoe (new-hire): Got it. Also, when I run `kubectl get pods -n model-serving` from laptop I see 502s, but jumpbox shows 200. Any onboarding routing quirks?
tess (sre): New hires sometimes miss internal route injection. Check `tailscale status` and `sudo ip route`. If 10.0.0.0/8 missing, re-run `tailscale up --authkey <yourkey>` or re-auth in the web UI. If still missing, ping infra.
zoe (new-hire): `ip route` missing the 10.0.0.0/8. Re-authed and it's back. Also noticed a runbook macro that hid the exec contact table until attachments perm was added  could confuse other new hires.
max (oncall-lead): Good catch, will flag to docs. Now shadowing policy: first two rotations are shadowed. You'll be paired with Max on night 1 and Tess on night 2. Pagerbot will schedule shadows and mock drill this weekend.
devx-bot: Reminder: Mock incident drill Sat 20:00 PT. Recording and slides will be uploaded.
zoe (new-hire): I'd like to swap the second shadow to Monday if possible (family thing). Is that allowed?
max (oncall-lead): Swaps ok with 24h notice and a volunteer. Post availability in #eng-oncall-swap. I'll approve once someone covers.
tess (sre): Quick debugging cheatsheet for model-serving in the runbook > Debugging > Model Pool: `curl -fsS /health`, `redis-cli INFO`, `kubectl logs -n model-serving -l app=ingress --tail 200`. Use the 'Fast Mitigations' only after consulting SRE: `kubectl scale deployment/model-ingress --replicas=0` and restart ingress.
zoe (new-hire): Thanks. During the mock drill, any expectation on what new hires should do?
max (oncall-lead): Mock drill is low-stress: ack the page, follow First Response checklist, post one-line status in Slack, and run two quick checks from the cheatsheet. We'll walk through escalation and exec notice drafting.
zoe (new-hire): Perfect. Last tiny question: OpsGenie sent duplicate alerts yesterday to a coworker  if I see that, who do I escalate to?
tess (sre): If it's duplicate spam, first mute the alert group briefly (runbook command), then notify #eng-oncall and DM me + infra-bot. If it's platform-wide, page infra-pager.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Zoe shadow with Max  2026-07-08 22:00-06:00 UTC. Good luck! :tada:
zoe (new-hire): Thanks everyone, excited to learn :smile:
